profile.description: Active county fair, but the fair managers have stated the City-owned grounds prohibit inflatables. The fair also began a five-year carnival contract in 2026.

notes.subject: City property rule prohibits inflatables; five-year carnival contract
notes.body: Jennifer Frieden and Tiffany Willis replied Aug. 4, 2026 that they loved the idea but had already told Dave the City owns the grounds and has a hard rule against inflatables on city property even when insured. Current official fair information confirms the 2026 fair is active Aug. 26-29 and states 2026 is the first year of a five-year carnival contract. This is a structural no for Adventure Zone under the current venue policy. Do not routinely re-contact unless the city rule or venue changes.
